title: Jaqaru language - Wikipedia
text: Jaqaru or Jacaru is a language of the Aymaran family. It is also known as Jaqi and Aru. It is spoken in the districts of Tupe and Catahuasi in Yauyos Province, Lima Region, Peru.

title: Aymaran languages
text: The Aymaran language family consists of Aymara and the closely related Jaqaru language (including the Kawki variety), with speaker populations varying significantly.
